messages:
cust-omega: Hey team — hitting a production break after we pinned a variant. Our embeddings suddenly dropped from 1536 dims to 1024 and our index pipeline errors out. Started right after the pinned upgrade around 02:10 UTC. Request id: req_9a1b2c3d. Any quick pointers? :worried:

sara: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a sample request + response (redact API key)? Also which model alias/version did you pin?

cust-omega: sure — curl we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-embeddings-large","input":["hello world"]}'
```
response (truncated):
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001, 0.002, /* ... total length: 1024 */]}], "model":"redwood-embeddings-large@v2"}
```
We expected 1536 for this customer (they've been on 1536 for months). We're using batch size ~8 via our client.

mike: quick questions — are you using any reserved/pinned variant config in the console or the API? Also is the model name aliased (eg redwood-embeddings-large -> redwood/embeddings-large@v3)? :eyes:

cust-omega: We pinned in console to "redwood-embeddings-large@v3" yesterday as part of deploy. Console shows the pin, but the response above says v2 — I can paste console screenshot if needed. We are also on eu-west-1 reserved capacity (customer region).

alex: possible theory: pinned routing worked but runtime fell back to a quantized/compat variant with reduced output dims (legacy quantized embed variant had 1024). Can you fetch model metadata from the control plane for that variant? e.g.
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/redwood-embeddings-large/meta
```
Look for output_embedding_size / variant tags.

support-bot: [deploy-bot] Pinned variant update: redwood-embeddings-large -> v3 completed by @ops at 2026-03-15T02:08:12Z on eu-west-1 (canary->pinned).

jess: repro step for you to try quickly: bypass batching for a single call and include header X-Redwood-Force-Model: redwood-embeddings-large@v3 to force no-routing. If the single-call still returns 1024 then routing + fallback isn't the cause. Example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" 
 -H "X-Redwood-Force-Model: redwood-embeddings-large@v3" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-embeddings-large","input":["test"]}'
```

cust-omega: ran the forced single-call (no batching) — still returns 1024. This only happens in eu-west-1; us-east is still 1536.

mike: ok that rules out client-side batching. Another possibility: stale model artifact cache on serving nodes (coldstart after pin). We had an edge case where the kernel selection cache kept a fallback artifact. If you can share an example request id (you already gave req_9a1b2c3d), I'll check logs for the pod id. Meanwhile can you run admin flush on model cache (if you have a support token we can guide), or we can restart the reserved pool.

cust-omega: I don't have admin rights. If you can run the flush that'd be great — customer is impacted.

mike: on it. Running cache flush for pinned variant on eu-west-1...
```bash
# internal admin action (support only)
POST https://internal.redwood.ai/admin/models/flush-cache 
{ "model": "redwood-embeddings-large@v3", "region": "eu-west-1" }
```

support-bot: [infra] model cache flush started for redwood-embeddings-large@v3 in eu-west-1 (job id job_44f).

mike: cache flush finished, restarting a few serving pods to be safe. Please re-run the single-call test when ready.

cust-omega: re-ran the forced single-call — embedding length is back to 1536. index pipeline resumed. Huge help, thanks. :relieved: 

sara: great — we'll leave this thread open for a few hours to watch for recurrence. Mike/Alex can you follow up with a postmortem note about cache invalidation edge-case and whether we should add an alarm for embedding-size drift after variant pin?

alex: noted. I'll add a regression check to the canary job: after pin, run a quick sample request and assert output dims == expected. Also add a metric to surface embed_dim mismatches per model+region.

jess: recommend customers get a canary window and auto-smoke-check after pins too. I'll draft a runbook snippet for ops.

sara: closing the customer incident in support UI as "mitigated" and flagging for follow-up. cust-omega — let us know if anything else shows up. :thumbsup:

cust-omega: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick fix."
